question: The volume of a right circular cylinder whose height is 20 cm and circumference of the base is 44 cm is: (Use π = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a circle, when Circumference = 44 cm, Radius = 7 cm and Base Area = 154 cm² (standard fixed values).

Volume of Cylinder = Base Area × Height

Volume = 154 × 20 = 3080 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 3080 cu. cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of the cylinder (h) = 20 cm

Circumference of the base (C) = 44 cm

**Formula Used:**

Circumference of a circle = 2πr

Volume of a cylinder = πr²h
